title: A Good Assortment of Items
text: A Good Assortment of Items. Tiered tray decorating has become a fun hobby for me. The major holidays are easy to find items for, but some themes, such as the lemon one, are more difficult. This has a good assortment of items. They are sized well for tiered trays. I like that it comes with the beads and the gnome as well as the phrase blocks. There's even a fake lemon! The pieces are sturdy and made well. They do have the mass produced look to them which means they are painted "too perfectly" and a little flat, but they still look nice and will do the job!
